statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is clinical suspicion for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is ordered
The service is to capture and characterize intermittent arrhythmic events
The service is for definitive diagnosis and management planning
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and I49.9
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
Cardiac event monitoring is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
